workingTarget: PostgreSQL18 from accepted ADR065; not an explicit owner dialect choice or delivered support

officialSource.pin: major18 plus observed source snapshot; not immutable patch

scopeLimits: Command reference pages are not a complete grammar/type/function/operator/catalog/protocol inventory.
No individual command or family is qualified by extraction, family mapping or lexical parser acceptance.
No dependency/API/auth/session/model/topology decision is made; all remaining semantic contracts need root approval.
No checkout writes, Git, build, tests, local native process or provider runtime executed.

missingCoverageGroups.pendingDecision: Foreign wrappers/tables/servers/user mappings and import have no named family. Freeze external provider ownership, credentials, remote outcomes, security, atomicity and bounded resource contracts.

Tablespaces and SQL large-object commands are not equivalent to canonical KeyLoad blobs or node placement. Freeze namespace, file/storage authority, replication, native client APIs and ownership without replacing ZoneTree.

Access methods, aggregate DDL, casts, collations, conversions, operator class/family, languages and transforms lack explicit catalog coverage. Freeze executable-code/type/operator/OID semantics and bounded safe evaluation; current scalar collations/aggregates labels do not specify this DDL.
Text-search configuration/dictionary/parser/template DDL is not named. ZoneTree.FullTextSearch evaluation is not PostgreSQL text-search catalog/type/ranking compatibility.
Extended statistics create/alter/drop lacks explicit DDL/catalog/planner definition. Freeze persistent statistics identity, collection cuts, null/collation behavior and plan invalidation.
Generic triggers/rules do not explicitly define event-trigger DDL firing, privileges, event ordering, rollback and recovery.
DISCARD is not listed. Freeze exact session/prepared/portal/cache/temporary ownership and cleanup before native session implementation.

COMMENT and SECURITY LABEL lack named object metadata/provider semantics. Freeze catalog visibility, object authorization, label providers and atomic updates; do not treat SQL comments as COMMENT DDL.
ALTER DEFAULT PRIVILEGES, DROP OWNED and REASSIGN OWNED need explicit persisted ownership/default privileges/dependency-cascade mapping; client roles remain untrusted.

Standalone VALUES, TRUNCATE, SELECT INTO, CREATE TABLE AS and REFRESH MATERIALIZED VIEW are not named. Freeze inferred types/nulls, atomic row/schema writes, snapshots, constraints, cascading, refresh concurrency and RF3 recovery.

ALTER SYSTEM and LOAD lack exact native administration contracts. Freeze persisted versus node-local settings, replication/restart and executable-library authority; no runtime loading/auth/topology choice is made by this inventory.
